title: Dispatcher position
statement: For a program $P$ and a Boolean flag $d$, let $F$ be the frame size of $P$. The dispatcher position is the end position obtained by processing the statements of $P$ starting at the first body position for $F$ and $d$.
caveat: The supplied snippet uses the frame size of a program without including its definition, so the statement names that quantity but cannot further specify it.
